class.name: Porion.Builds.Models.Build_Status
class.comment: Summary of information about last builds of a project.

property.name: pass_count
property.comment: the number of tests that succeeded.

property.name: fail_count
property.comment: the number of tests that failed.

property.name: timeout_count
property.comment: the number of tests that timeout.

query.name: project-build-status
query.comment: Get the build status of every recipes of a project
query.sql: SELECT recipe.id, build.status, build.tag, build.number, build.pass_count, build.fail_count, build.timeout_count, build.finish_date FROM porion_recipe AS recipe INNER JOIN porion_last_build AS last_build ON last_build.recipe_id = recipe.id INNER JOIN porion_build AS build ON last_build.build_id = build.id WHERE recipe.project_id = 1 AND build.id IN (SELECT MAX(sb.build_id) FROM porion_last_build AS sb WHERE sb.recipe_id = recipe.id)
